themes_detail.label: Cannabis Retailer Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Cannabis retailer complaints jumped 331% last week (7 complaints vs. 1.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks), signaling either rapid illegal dispensary openings or enforcement gaps in newly legal retail landscape.
evidence: 7 cannabis retailer complaints last week vs. 1.6 weekly average (331% increase, z-score: 5.42)
Spike emerged in most recent reporting week, indicating acute and recent problem
High statistical significance (z-score 5.42) suggests real pattern, not noise
reporting_angles: Are unlicensed cannabis shops opening in Brownsville/Ocean Hill faster than city can license or shut down?
Interview residents and community board about enforcement gaps and quality-of-life impacts

themes_detail.label: Derelict Vehicles Piling Up
themes_detail.summary: Derelict vehicle complaints nearly tripled over the past 2 weeks (16 complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 5.5 weekly average), suggesting either a concentration of abandoned cars or lax towing enforcement.
evidence: 16 derelict vehicle complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 5.5 weekly average (191% increase, z-score: 3.71)
Sustained issue emerging in last 2 weeks with strong statistical signal
Impacts street safety, visual blight, and resident mobility
reporting_angles: Walk streets to photo document abandoned vehicles; map hotspots
Interview NYPD and Sanitation about response times and removal procedures

themes_detail.label: Tree Damage & Overgrowth Crisis
themes_detail.summary: Illegal tree damage complaints exploded 1500% three weeks ago (4 vs. 0.2 average) and overgrown tree complaints spiked 900%, together suggesting either storm damage aftermath or systemic Parks Department neglect.
evidence: Illegal tree damage: 4 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.2 weekly average (1500% increase, z-score: 8.66)
Overgrown trees: 5 complaints 3 weeks ago vs. 0.5 weekly average (900% increase, z-score: 4.5)
Both spikes emerged in same 3-week window, suggesting common cause (storm event or systemic failure)
reporting_angles: Investigate whether recent weather events triggered damage or if Parks lacks maintenance capacity
Document safety hazards (branches over power lines, blocked sidewalks) affecting pedestrians

themes_detail.label: Garbage Collection Failures
themes_detail.summary: Missed collection complaints tripled last week (6 complaints vs. 1.5 weekly average), suggesting Sanitation service disruption or operational breakdown in the district.
evidence: 6 missed collection complaints last week vs. 1.5 weekly average (300% increase, z-score: 3.4)
Spike is brand-new (last week only), indicating acute, current problem
While unsanitary conditions complaints dropped 55% this week, missed collections spiked, suggesting delayed cleanup rather than persistent filth
reporting_angles: Contact Sanitation Department to determine if route changes, staffing shortages, or equipment failures caused collection lapses
Document piling trash on streets; interview residents about health and pest concerns

themes_detail.label: Smoking/Vaping Complaints Double
themes_detail.summary: Smoking and vaping complaints more than tripled two weeks ago (5 complaints vs. 1.4 weekly average), pointing to either increased enforcement awareness or a new congregation point for smokers.
evidence: 5 smoking/vaping complaints 2 weeks ago vs. 1.4 weekly average (264% increase, z-score: 4.23)
Emerged 2 weeks ago with sustained signal
Could reflect indoor smoking violations or outdoor nuisance at specific locations
reporting_angles: Identify if complaints cluster around bars, parks, or residential buildings
Interview residents about secondhand smoke health impacts and enforcement outcomes
